pack: influences.sgit.ai brief pack v0.33.62, 25 August 2026 — from Dinis Cruz, via the SG/Send Librarian
attribution: Dinis Cruz, with AI co-authorship (Claude, Anthropic)
note: Word counts are from wc -w on the published files, not from the pack's own manifest — where the two disagree the file wins.

documents.title: The brief pack — read me first
documents.blurb: What the pack is, what each document does, and the tier accounting: 15 traced, 7 stated, 3 discovered across 25 entries, with the seed JSON declared authoritative and the counts to be regenerated from it.

documents.title: 00 — The brief
documents.blurb: The commission itself. The name decided, the format already invented, the thesis that this is the provenance layer of the memory network, the three-tier map with its evidence, the honest constraints, and the build order this site was written in.

documents.title: 01 — The register format
documents.blurb: The seven blocks, canonised from Dinis Cruz's own Bret Victor register — a format proven in use before it was designed. Plus the three reduced forms (link-out, stub, discovered) and the entry metadata schema.

documents.title: 02 — The influence map
documents.blurb: Every entry with its corpus evidence, quotes and paths. Twelve traced influences with file counts, Dinis Cruz's stated seven with zero grep hits, five discovered by mining — and the composition view showing the influences are a graph, not a list.

documents.title: 03 — Site architecture
documents.blurb: The URL scheme, the data model, the rule that tier movement is the site's changelog, the special role the comms page plays as a briefing-request queue, the infographic rules, and what the site deliberately does not do.

documents.title: 04 — Boundaries and licensing
documents.blurb: The no-verbatim rule as licence armour: link never rehost, short attributed quotation for analysis only, lyrics as the sharpest edge, likenesses as original artwork only, and the split an agent ingesting llms-full.txt inherits.

documents.title: 05 — Gaps and open questions
documents.blurb: Five gaps the pack owns — the missing full register text, the seven evidence-less entries, two decades of unmined publications, the incomplete trace tables, the artwork — and seven questions only Dinis Cruz can answer.

documents.title: The immediate-connection register — the structural summary
documents.blurb: The model entry, in summary. The anchor, and a description of the register's five patterns, two gap specs, six-point checklist and closing argument. The full text is with Dinis Cruz and is the first ask in the comms queue.

documents.title: The pack's licence
documents.blurb: CC BY 4.0 on the pack, the seed data and the site's own content — and the explicit list of what it does not cover: every anchor work, which belongs to its author.

documents.title: influences__seed.json — the seed register
documents.blurb: The pack's own machine-readable register: 25 entries with tier, kind, status, anchor, corpus evidence and research plans. This site's data/influences.json is seeded from it.

documents.title: 09__source-manifest.csv — the source manifest
documents.blurb: Every source the mining run used, with its tier, path, word count and role — including the two rows marked DO-NOT-PUBLISH-YET and PENDING, which are why two of this site's entries are stubs.
